title: 6.3 Biomes of Ethiopia
description: Major biomes in Ethiopia including afroalpine, montane forest, savanna, desert, and aquatic ecosystems with endemic species

questions.question: Which Ethiopian biome is found at the highest altitudes, typically above 3,200 meters?
What is a characteristic feature of the afroalpine biome in Ethiopia?
options: Tall trees forming a dense canopy
Sandy soil with very little vegetation
Low temperatures and high solar radiation
Two separate eggs fertilized by two sperm

questions.question: Which giant plant is a well-known endemic species of the Ethiopian afroalpine biome?
